findings.finding: Baseline defaults include conservative aiding noise; adapter overrides must be distinguished from these defaults.
Optical-flow best/worst standard deviations are floored at 0.05 rad/s.
Vector magnetic observation variance is floored at (0.01 Gauss)^2.
Bias rate covariance increments scale as (prediction dt times native noise parameter)^2 before native inhibition and constraints.
Range parameter is documented as RMS noise in metres with advertised range 0.1 to 10; default is 0.5.
Flow standard deviation floor is 0.05 rad/s. Terrain range fusion consumes _rngNoise directly as observation variance, without squaring or the height-path clamp.
Range height fusion squares _rngNoise after clamping its standard deviation to 0.1 through 10. This differs dimensionally from terrain fusion.
Heading standard deviation floor is 0.05 rad; vector magnetic floor is 0.01 Gauss, plus a motion-dependent variance.
Integrated bias covariance increments scale as (dt squared times native process-noise parameter)^2. Dividing by dt squared yields common bias-rate covariance.

scope: Read-only audit of the pinned upstream releases. No upstream implementation is copied into this repository.
